title: National Theatre of Costa Rica
geometryBasis: The OSM envelope fixes the axes and width and depth. The photograph and the archival architectural analysis fix the narrower vestibule, broader auditorium wings and narrower stage-end block.
sectionBasis: The Pan American Union photograph shows the front and south elevation. The architectural study documents the west, south and east elevations, plans 20512 and 20559, the metal gables and the square stage dome with eight round openings.
limitations: This models the durable main theatre exterior and original architectural organization. Detached ticket offices, fences and movable interiors are outside the model scope.
Stone coloration, individual reliefs, roof fittings and the profiles of the restored replicas are approximated at landmark resolution. Mapzen terrain captures the site grade at provider grid spacing.
